# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (34 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from src/geox_mcp/tools_manifest.yaml

## 1. Canonical Tool Surface

1. **geox_well_ingest**: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
2. **geox_well_qc**: Quality control checks on well data: depth monotonicity, null percentages, physical range checks, curve completeness.
3. **geox_well_desk_open**: OBSERVE · Open GEOX well-desk interactive view (SEP-1865 MCP App). Read-only operator summary for a well_id. Hosts with UI open ui://geox/well-desk; hosts without UI still receive structured JSON. No mutation.

4. **geox_well_desk_publish**: MUTATE · Publish a rendered well-desk image with embedded metadata. Saves image to /root/GEOX/data/renders/ and seals to VAULT999.

5. **geox_render_well_panel**: OBSERVE · Render a well-log panel as a PNG image with metadata. Generates GR, RT, NPHI, RHOB, DT tracks for a given well_id.

6. **geox_petrophysics**: Compute petrophysical properties: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay. Includes LEM physics-prior inference.
7. **geox_sequence**: Sequence stratigraphy analysis: GR binning, parasequence packages, systems tract inference, well correlation.
8. **geox_seismic_ingest**: Load and inspect seismic data: SEG-Y headers, trace counts, sample intervals, volume metadata.
9. **geox_seismic_compute**: Unified seismic physics: synthetics, well ties, AVO analysis, attributes. Time-depth anchoring uses checkshot data only. Modes include tie_preflight, tie_receipt, wavelet_extract, mistie_rms, time_depth_calibrate (ZEN G1).
10. **geox_seismic_interpret**: Seismic interpretation: horizon detection, fault picking, volume blending, frame extraction.
11. **geox_vision**: Vision-based seismic interpretation using VLMs: analyze seismic images, audit interpretations, calibrate models.
12. **geox_subsurface_model**: Multi-physics subsurface modeling: joint inversion, gravity/magnetic forward modeling, MT/CSEM forward modeling.
13. **geox_gravmag_studio_open**: GEOX GravMag Studio v0.1 — forward-only MCP App. Computes gravity or magnetic anomaly from a prism model via HarmonICAdapter (mock or live) and returns the studio iframe payload at ui://geox/gravmag-studio.html. Verdict is always QUALIFY (never SEAL) — Stage A is forward-only.
14. **geox_gravmag_studio_screen**: GEOX GravMag Studio v0.2 — Stage B screen (falsification lane). Forward-predicts via geox_gravmag_studio_open, compares against observed_grid, returns misfit stats + verdict (PASS_SCREEN / MARGINAL / FAIL_SCREEN / HOLD) + structured abduction discipline. Never SEALs. Confidence capped at 0.70 per F7 HUMILITY. Unit or grid mismatch returns HOLD (fail-closed).
15. **geox_geomechanics**: Geomechanical analysis: elastic moduli (K, G, E, Poisson ratio), coordinate transforms, block resolution.
16. **geox_basin**: Basin intelligence: profiles, resolution, deep time state, Macrostrat API, spatial context, scene rendering.
17. **geox_deep_time_state**: Earth state vector at any geological age: plate polygons, basin architecture, paleobathymetry, heat flow, subsidence.
18. **geox_surface_status**: GEOX organ health check: version, tool count, canonical surface status, registration timestamp.
19. **geox_claim**: Geological claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, attach evidence to structured interpretation claims.
20. **geox_evidence**: Evidence discovery and synthesis: search corpus, cross-domain synthesis, hypothesis generation, contradiction scanning.
21. **geox_prospect**: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, probability of success, expected value of information, risk assessment.
22. **geox_map_context_scene**: Spatial context scene: renders map layers, basins, and well locations for geographic orientation.
23. **geox_contrast_detect**: Anomalous contrast detection: identify seismic-geological mismatches at formation boundaries.
24. **geox_biostrat_parse**: Biostratigraphic data parsing: extract age-diagnostic fossil markers from well reports.
25. **geox_biostrat_falsify**: Biostratigraphic falsification: test fossil age assignments against stratigraphic constraints.
26. **geox_basin_backstrip**: Basin backstripping: decompact sedimentary layers and reconstruct subsidence history.
27. **geox_sediment_mass_balance**: Sediment mass balance: compute volumetric budgets and sediment supply rates for basin analysis.
28. **geox_thermal_maturity_history**: Thermal maturity history: model burial, heat flow, and vitrinite reflectance evolution over time.
29. **geox_claim_graph_evaluate**: Tool: geox_claim_graph_evaluate
30. **geox_consequence_footprint**: Compute physical and ecological consequences of a proposed action
31. **geox_optionality_loss**: Measure destroyed future physical options
32. **geox_feedback_integrity**: Check whether physical monitoring is sufficient to detect drift
33. **geox_material_truth_challenge**: Compare institutional claims against Earth measurements
34. **geox_cascade_pathway**: Model cross-domain propagation from a physical event

## 2. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
